walkthrough: Goal: see what lies on each layer without hiding the others, copy a layer to try something on it, give layers names, and change their order by moving a row, as in Procreate's layer panel.

Entry: open OpenPaint on the tablet (2880 x 1800, landscape) on an empty library. Draw a black wave with the pen: it lands on Layer 1. Tap Layers in the right island: the panel grows out of the button. Layer 1's row starts with a small picture of its own layer, the wave in ink on a light checker (the checker is where the layer is empty), then its name, its mode letter and its eye.

Tap Add layer: Layer 2 appears above, chosen, its picture an empty checker. With the panel open draw an arc across the wave with the pen outside the panel: the panel closes and the arc lies on Layer 2. Open the panel again: Layer 2's picture shows the arc alone and Layer 1's still the wave alone. A picture changes when a stroke has lifted or an edit is made, never while the pen moves; with the panel closed nothing is computed.

Duplicate: the footer's last row reads Rename and Group as words, then the copy and delete icons. Tap the copy icon (Duplicate layer): a second Layer 2 appears right above Layer 2 and becomes the chosen one, with the same picture, mode, opacity and mask; the canvas shows the arc twice over itself (stronger only where it is soft). Undo removes the copy, redo brings it back: one step.

Rename: tap Rename. A dialog grows out of it under the islands, headed Rename layer, with the name in a text field, all of it selected, and the keyboard up. Type Sky and tap Done: the chosen row reads Sky. Cancel, the back button or a tap outside the dialog change nothing. The name is an artwork change like any other in the panel: one undo step brings the old name back, redo the new one.

Move a layer: press and hold Layer 1's row; after a moment it lifts (an ink outline on paper) and follows the finger or the pen; the other rows make room as it passes them (they slide, as on any reorder). Let go above Sky: Layer 1 drops into that place and lies on top of the stack, the wave over the arcs. Rows of a group take a dropped layer in; at a group's edge the layer steps out of the group or into it as the old move up and down buttons did, and the lifted row's indent shows which. One undo puts the order back. A finger moving at once (without holding) scrolls the list as before; a short tap still chooses the row.
A mask's row shows the mask's grey as its picture: tap Add Mask: the Layer Mask row under the chosen layer shows white; paint on it with black and its picture shows the black where it hides.
Leave the app and let the system close it, open it again: the names, the copies and the order are as left; the pictures come back when the panel opens.

Failure: Duplicate is grey at 256 layers; Rename's Done is grey while the field holds no name (empty or only spaces). Not built: Merge Down (its representation is the author's call, STATUS), a group's picture, dragging a whole group.
